# superset_theme (Data Source)

Looks up a theme by its name, on Superset 6, for example to apply one of the built-in themes (`THEME_DEFAULT`, `THEME_DARK`) to a dashboard or to read its tokens. Theme names are not unique: the lookup fails when no theme matches, or when several do.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_theme" "dark" {
  name = "THEME_DARK"
}

resource "superset_dashboard" "sales" {
  title    = "Sales"
  theme_id = data.superset_theme.dark.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the theme. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the theme.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether the theme is one of the built-in themes of Superset, which cannot be edited.
- `json_data` (String) Design tokens of the theme, as a JSON document.
- `system_dark` (Boolean) Whether the theme is the dark theme of the instance.
- `system_default` (Boolean) Whether the theme is the default theme of the instance.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the theme, as export bundles reference it.
